"The Digital Personal Data Protection Bill, 2023, which is the revised version of the bill which was put up for public consultation earlier, has been approved by the cabinet on 5th July 2023. This is a historic moment as it is the first Act of the Parliament of India where "she/her" pronouns were used unlike the usual "he/him" pronouns. The bill aims to protect the autonomy and privacy of individuals in relation to their personal data, to create a safe and trusted environment for individuals to operate within the digital ecosystem, and to prevent any harm, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, disseclosure, storage, processing or other operations to personal data. The bill is a dynamic and living instrument, and it will be inclusive, and additions and refinements will continue to be made over time.
